title: Fizz Rock Delivery
description: Fizz Rock Delivery — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Kingdom Representative

Quest Type: Delivery

Quest Description: Deliver a sample of the Fizz Rocks to Audrey in Townston

Quest Reward: 500 Gold

Return to: Audrey the Alchemist in Townston

Repeatable: No

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Deliver the Fizz Rock Sample to Audrey the Alchemist in Townston.

Offer:

4 random potions!

Turn-in:

Sir Prize would like me to analyze a sample? Sure...anything for the glory of the King. Now...give the sample here. I'll forward a TPS report to the Commander as soon as I'm done with the analysis.

Since you're new to town, you're entitled to some free samples of potions that I sell. But, only the first couple are free--after that you'll have to rely on me for your potion needs!

Objectives:

  • Fizz Rock Sample ×1

Level range: 4–15
